embeds.title: 🎮 It's Game Night Wednesday!
embeds.description: That time of the week is here — join us for another night of friendly competition and good times!

fields.name: 📅 Every Wednesday
fields.value: Every week we get together for a night of fun and friendly competition. Whether you're a longtime regular or jumping in for the first time, everyone's welcome. Get in here and let's have a good time!
